description: Trend graphs. Adjust the time range as needed.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "modbus" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name =~ /pv[1-4]_power/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["name"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      "PV Total":
        (if exists r.pv1_power then r.pv1_power else float(v: "NaN")) +
        (if exists r.pv2_power then r.pv2_power else float(v: "NaN")) +
        (if exists r.pv3_power then r.pv3_power else float(v: "NaN")) +
        (if exists r.pv4_power then r.pv4_power else float(v: "NaN"))
  }))

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "name"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "jkbms" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.name == "cell_max" or r.name == "cell_min") and (r.bank == "a" or r.bank == "b"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: r._value,
      series: (if r.bank == "a" then "A " else "B ") + (if r.name == "cell_max" then "max" else "min"),
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "soc_estimate" and r._field == "value" and r.name == "soc_est")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.bank == "a" or r.bank == "b")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value:
        if r.source == "track" then 0.0
        else if r.source == "coast_jk" then 1.0
        else if r.source == "coast_inverters" then 2.0
        else if r.source == "held" then 3.0
        else if r.source == "full_anchor" then 4.0
        else if r.source == "empty_anchor" then 5.0
        else -1.0,
      series: if r.bank == "a" then "Bank A" else "Bank B",
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
